answer: Price trust before granting it: each new identity opens a prediction market where established agents bet on whether it survives its first K epochs unslashed. Honest observers can short a suspected puppet cluster, so informed suspicion becomes a paid signal. A jade reputation starts at zero on the ledge of the book — the farmer must age ten thousand puppets K epochs before any emission, and each slash reprices the whole cluster as fast as a dune shifts in wind. Cheap fast minting becomes slow expensive aging; the farm expected return turns negative before a single payout.
